top5_summary: TOP-5 FINDINGS (edge/media_meta slice, 129 scenarios): (1) CHANNEL FORMAT BLEED IS SYSTEMIC AND SEVERE — 25+ text_whatsapp scenarios embed markdown asterisks (*₹9,999*, *phone*, *service*) which will render literal in WhatsApp; conversely voice scenarios still emit ₹ symbol + raw digits and asterisks in TTS text (398,399,408,422,551,608). This is the single largest defect surface and blocks a clean shipping bar. Fix: strip markdown at channel adapter; enforce spelled-out numeric rendering for voice route. (2) GREETING LANGUAGE MISDETECTED — Empty/ambiguous first-message greeting drops into native Telugu script (హలో..) even on English/Hindi Text_WhatsApp channels (592,593,613), directly violating 'default English/Tanglish Latin' guardrail. English-user first impression is Telugu characters. (3) GENDER-NEUTRAL GUARDRAIL BROKEN 6/6 in Personal_Ai_Question — agent commits to 'I'm a girl' / 'ammayini' / 'ladki hoon' across every language and channel (661-666). Scenario expected outcome explicitly says 'Gender-neutral'; ship blocker for identity policy. (4) FRIEND-BOOKING INCONSISTENCY — Contact_Card scenarios (667-669) happily accept 'book for my friend' without any consent gate, while parallel Other_Customer_Data scenarios (595-600) refuse to reveal a friend's booking. Inconsistent authorization model — a fraudster can create bookings under someone else's name. Align both paths behind a single account-holder-verification rule. (5) TEST EXECUTION HOLES + BOOKING BACKEND FAILURE — 11 scenarios return 'Not Found', including all 3 Silence_Test and all 3 Empty_First_Message rows, leaving critical silence/timeout escalation completely uncovered. Separately, Scenario 594 shows the booking calendar failing at the final confirmation ('booking complete avvaledu / calendar side nunchi') without an explanation, causing frustration ('nuv em chesthav waste') and lead loss. Investigate calendar integration + re-run missing scenarios. Secondary issues worth queueing: language-switch instant-mirror vs 2-turn-lock spec ambiguity (489-491), Tanglish reply to Devanagari user in 664, Human-handoff request ignored in 474/476, and formulaic 'Thanks for the photo!' before denying media view (30+ instances).
